operations.body: Built as part of PR #5 (merged f015999): web/src/data/sleeper.ts (8 calls at once, retry with back-off on 429 and 5xx, clear errors), feeds.ts (values file kept 20 hours, snapshots by commit id from the published index, only the weeks a league's trades need), with progress reported to the page. Snapshots are fetched 6 at a time with one retry.
